findings.source_quote: He was at the crossroads, all his life as a whole.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace «med hele livet sitt på spill» with «med hele livet foran seg ved et veiskille» to retain the idea of a crossroads concerning his life as a whole, without suggesting his life is at stake.
findings.translation_quote: Han sto ved et veiskille, med hele livet sitt på spill.
